system.description:
Each successful Strike forces the target to make a CR 1 Luck Check. On a fail it's flung into the nearest enemy, goes Prone and takes 2 Blunt damage; that enemy then makes the same CR 1 check and the chain continues on each fail. With no enemy to hit, the Director improvises (terrain or a Status Effect).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.59

onHit.note: Domino Effect: if the CR 1 Luck save fails, the enemy also takes 2 Blunt damage and crashes into the nearest enemy, which makes its own CR 1 Luck Check (repeat on a failure).

automation.note: Applies to every successful Strike: pick the Domino Effect mode when you Strike with a weapon. Deal the 2 Blunt damage and run the chain by hand; with no enemy nearby the Director improvises.
